fullDesc: On July 4, 2012 scientists at CERN in Switzerland announced the discovery of a particle consistent with the Higgs boson, predicted in 1964. Peter Higgs and François Englert shared the 2013 Nobel Prize in Physics.
realFacts: It was found at the Large Hadron Collider
Its mass is roughly 130 times that of a proton
It completed the Standard Model of particle physics
It took nearly 50 years to find
